newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were mixed to slightly lower at the end of trade, closing off early highs with shorter rates rising late in the session.
Money market traders reported no unusual activity in the afternoon, however. The Swiss National Bank (SNB) was seen adding liquidity during the morning in routine operations.

One bank said the late rise in short rates may have been partly tied to the Swiss franc's latest declines. The Swiss franc was fairly steady Monday after losing ground against the dollar. But it eased against the mark, pushing mark/Swiss back near levels last seen before a prolongued drop began in July.
Traders said that overall the trend for Swiss bonds still appeared positive.
"The market is a bit weaker compared with this morning. But overall the tone is still favourable," said one trader.
"The morning wasn't bad. But trade went to sleep in the afternoon," a second trader said.

In the corporate sector, traders said some recent issues, which had become illiquid after mostly being placed, had lost ground relative to the market as a whole. The same issues had gained compared to the rest of the market in recent sessions, traders said.
